description: Which QuickBooks accounts a supplier invoice may be coded to (the review page's picker and the approval check). By QuickBooks account type and detail type (AccountSubType), never by name, so it works on any company's chart.

hidden_detail_types.UnappliedCashBillPaymentExpense: QuickBooks system account for unapplied bill payments
hidden_detail_types.AccumulatedDepreciation: contra-asset: only depreciation entries post here
hidden_detail_types.Inventory: inventory asset: moved by item purchases, not by expense coding
hidden_detail_types.UndepositedFunds: money received but not yet deposited: never a cost

hidden_default_names.note: QuickBooks' default US names for its catch-all accounts, which share generic detail types with real accounts, so they can only be recognised by name. For a company set up in another language, add the localized names here.
